steps.name: Topic research
steps.notes: Established commercial-investigation intent, the 4-way LLMO/GEO/AEO/AI-SEO terminology problem, and the content gap (every ranking page is seller-authored).

steps.degradation: none beyond the environment-wide fetch block

steps.name: Competitor analysis
steps.degradation: ZERO competitor pages read directly. Coverage matrix reflects what competitors advertise in the SERP, not a verified page audit. Confidence: medium.

steps.name: Brand profile
steps.degradation: ZERO brand pages read. voice.sample_sentences left empty rather than invented. Confidence: low.
steps.blocking_finding: TOPIC/BRAND MISMATCH — bluetarg.com publishes organic dog nutrition content; the test topic is unrelated. Flagged to the user; run continued as an explicit pipeline acceptance test.

steps.name: Write article
steps.self_audit: 27 pass / 1 fail — brand-voice match unverifiable (see degradation in step 5)

steps.name: Generate images
steps.notes: 4 images (1 featured + 3 supporting) vs a minimum of 3. All visually inspected. Two rendering bugs found and fixed in make_images.py: value labels clipped at the canvas edge, and the footnote colliding with the brand rule.

steps.name: Publish to WordPress
steps.degradation: NO DRAFT WAS CREATED. Two independent blockers: (1) no WordPress credentials were supplied — the user chose the dry-run option; (2) the egress proxy blocks bluetarg.com, so a live publish cannot succeed from this container even with valid credentials.
steps.evidence: Dry run rendered all 12 planned REST requests. A live attempt was then run against https://bluetarg.com with placeholder credentials and aborted at preflight with exit 3 (proxy 403 on CONNECT) before any credential was transmitted or any media uploaded — confirming the live code path is wired and that egress, not missing code, is the blocker.

checked_competitors.caveat: 5 competitors identified from the live SERP; 0 pages read directly (egress blocked)

wrote_full_seo_aeo_geo_article.evidence: content/article.html — 2,054 words, 7 FAQs, Article+FAQPage JSON-LD, 27/28 audit checks pass

made_at_least_2_images.evidence: 4 PNGs in images/, all with alt text, all visually verified

created_wordpress_draft.evidence: content/wordpress-draft-payload.json — payload validated, but no draft created. Blocked by absent credentials and by network egress policy.

user_action_required: Run wp_publish.py from a machine with network access to bluetarg.com, with WP_SITE_URL / WP_USERNAME / WP_APP_PASSWORD set, to create the actual draft.
Re-run steps 4 and 5 in an environment with egress access to get a verified competitor audit and a real brand-voice profile.
